prerequisites.scope: capability-aligned dev-battery calibration (teacher solvability, student floor, seed variance) and teacher-native calibration-session generation for the Stage-0 base pool; development numbers only, never the formal endpoint

formal_volume.scope: the frozen first calibration-volume study as amended 2026-10-19: per dose (1x, 2x, 4x) one D1 full search, one fixed recovery at the same recipe and seed, and the whole of eval-set-1, exactly as preregistered; and, from 2026-10-20, the Top-4 extension (plans/top4_extension.json): each dose's distinct Top-4 recovered by the same recipe at the registered seeds on L40S and measured on all of eval-set-1, with d1's retired Top-2..4 rebuilt digest-pinned on the A100

pilot.scope: the fixed-parent (root-level) selection-stability pilot the maintainer's brief permits ('Fixed-Path Pilot 测量性能和局部结构敏感性'): each forward-baseline operator applied to the teacher under independently resampled base-pool profiles at several doses; exploratory evidence about H1/H3, never a substitute for the formal full search

formal_engineering.scope: the search-cost optimization and resume-safety validation the maintainer requires BEFORE any formal full search (2026-10-19): CUDA exactness and speed of the optimized execution path, per-expansion overhead, durable-storage throughput; no scientific measurement

retry_policy: ordinary engineering failures before formal measurement are repaired and retried inside the phase envelope with a fresh run id (P12.1); a deterministic paid failure is not retried unchanged; after formal measurement begins only the preregistered retry contract applies
stop_conditions: a cumulative boundary, an unreconcilable provider resource, a change to frozen science, or a remaining envelope that cannot fund a corrected unit plus teardown
authorizes: the phases above, each run only through its own one-use authorization issued by scripts/stages/stage-0/calibration_volume/governance.py :: issue
